card.name: Numbers and units in lab thresholds
card.fires_on: The marked piece inside a numeric threshold or unit expression, such as "to" after "greater than or equal", the 9 in "10 9 /L", or the 2 in "m 2". Mostly in dosing-adjustment tables for blood counts and body surface area.

modes.label: Blood count thresholds
modes.description: The word "to" or the exponent 9 in counts like platelets or ANC cutoffs.
modes.example: Use the lowest dose of DOPTELET needed to achieve and maintain a platelet count greater than or equal to 50×10 <<9>> /L as necessary to reduce the risk

modes.label: Body surface area units
modes.description: The superscript 2 in m 2 within dose-by-BSA formulas.
modes.example: calculate the dose based on treatment day: Dose (mcg) = Daily dosage (mcg/m 2 ) × BSA (m <<2>> ) Recommended Dosage and Administration in Patients
